Name: Eunoia's Nyapu Colored Sprites
Author: eunoiamods
Description:
[size=6][b]Eunoia’s Nyapu Coloured Sprites[/b][/size]

A project to recolour sprites in the bright colours favoured by Nyapu and select portrait makers.

After a long wait, the vanilla sprites are now complete as of the 5th June 2025. Sprites include all characters with an overworld sprite, excluding certain cutscene specific characters and sprite sheets. Thank you for the community response, your kindness and your patience, I really do appreciate it.

[b]Please[/b] let me know if you have any problems!

[i][b]Please[/b][b] don't[/b][/i] ask if I'm planning to make a version with a more muted colour palette or darker outlines. I appreciate you love the mod enough to want to use it in your game but there are many mods catering to that style, including some of the mods I've used to make this! Try checking them out instead.
[b][size=4]
Supported Mods & Expansions[/size][/b]

-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265] Romanceable Rasmodia[/url] by Nom0ri (perhaps other female wizard mods? Only tested for RR.)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31520]Shirtless Sebby and Shane[/url] by Blossom5280
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ by FlashShifter (Currently only vanilla characters with extra sprites.)

[b][size=4]Design Philosophy[/size][/b]

I’ve always loved Poltergeister’s vanilla-plus character sprites, but their sprites often don’t align with my chosen portrait mod by Nyapu. Thanks to their generous asset use policies, I’ve adapted Poltergeister’s sprites to match Nyapu’s portraits, by colour matching, drawing outfits and, in general, tweaking them to my taste.

Along the way, I started the process of drawing sprites from my own bases, just to really customise the characters to better fit my vision. This quickly got way out of the scope of the initial premise of the mod! Since returning from a hiatus, I’ve now decided to split my work into two mods - Eunoia’s Nyapu Coloured Sprites (this mod!) and Eunoia’s Sprite Project, which will be my new focus going forward.

Eunoia’s Nyapu Coloured Sprites will be for a more basic colour matched version of sprites, which are much quicker to produce, while Eunoia’s Sprite Project will be for my almost-completely custom sprites, in my own spriting style. Neither are necessarily better, (it’s a matter of personal taste,) but the latter is made with more attention and care to the player experience.

[b][size=4]Future Plans
[/size][/b]
- Player Character Recolor
- Baby & Toddler Recolors
- SVE Recolor

Eventually, other expansions may follow, but it isn’t a current priority until SVE is done.

[size=4][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]

When the mod is added to an existing save, the changes may fail to load properly. This can be fixed by changing the config to a different
option and back again. Any other problems, let me know!
